text:
maria.g: quick RFC follow-up  sketched a tiny observability payload for quant artifacts (fp8/int8/4bit). want fast sanity check before PR.
samir: nice. question: tie to profile only or model+profile+route?
maria.g: model+profile+route so we can map regressions to customer routes.
li: nit: use snake_case, add event_id + profile_version + severity bucket {low,medium,high}.
aj: ops ask: provide a compact json example and prometheus-friendly labels.
maria.g: example (redacted): model=redwood-v2-medium; profile_id=fp8-aggressive-2026-11; profile_version=1; route=/chat/generate; event_id=evt-20261101-1; severity=high; degrade_score=0.82; fidelity_budget=0.12; anchor=qa_v2; anchor_examples=[weather_short]; token_index=17; residual_norm=0.04; sample_snippet="[redacted] lost dates"; redaction=true; metadata_ttl=1209600; sample_ttl=604800; explainability_collected=false; collect_cost_ms=0.5; collect_size_bytes=20480
jenna: metrics to emit: quant_artifact_count, quant_degrade_p50/p95, quant_anchor_regressions, quant_residual_norm_avg. include labels model/profile/route/severity/customer_tier.
samir: heavy Q - token-level explainability? helpful but expensive and sensitive.
maria.g: gated opt-in for canaries/customers; admin-only retrieval and audit logging. default off.
aj: ops requirement: mandatory redaction pipeline for sample_snippet and two-tier TTLs.
li: add artifact_resolution event with resolution_reason enum {rollout_rollback,profile_tweak,false_positive,noop} and resolver_name/notes to close loop.
maria.g: will open PR with snake_case schema, console mockups (diff vs anchor), a tiny logger shim, runbook (redaction/TTLs/admin), and microbench numbers. tagging reviewers.
ops-bot: maria.g mentioned samir, aj, li, jenna in #eng-ml
